subject.title: fix(vydra): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Should the bundled Vydra plugin treat a generated asset URL on the configured provider origin as trusted enough to forward provider authorization and configured request headers?
rationale: The implementation has a clear cross-origin credential-drop rule and credible proof, but the remaining choice is whether same-origin generated-media downloads are an approved credential boundary rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Accept the same-origin boundary
options.body: Approve forwarding the resolved Vydra headers only to assets whose origin exactly matches the normalized configured provider origin, while keeping all cross-origin downloads headerless.

options.title: Require unauthenticated asset downloads
options.body: Keep submit and polling policy propagation but remove authorization and custom-header forwarding from every generated-media download, accepting that authenticated same-origin assets may fail.

recommendation.title: Accept the same-origin boundary
recommendation.body: Approve forwarding the resolved Vydra headers only to assets whose origin exactly matches the normalized configured provider origin, while keeping all cross-origin downloads headerless.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the adjacent Vydra download timeout boundary most affected by the policy decision.
